name: Antyeshthi Sahay Yojana
benefit: A one-time financial assistance of ₹5,000/- is provided to the heirs of a senior citizen who was receiving old-age assistance at the time of their death. This assistance is intended to help with funeral expenses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be the heir of a deceased senior citizen. 1. The deceased must have been a beneficiary of old-age assistance.
